import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('file:data/guidebook.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
langs=['EN','DE','NO','SV','FR','NL','DA','FI','ES','IT','PT','JA','KO','ZH']
terms=[r[0] for r in con.execute("select term_id from terms order by term_id")]
print('per-language: terms with >=1 alias (non-DEPRECATED)')
for L in langs:
    have=con.execute("select count(distinct term_id) from term_aliases where upper(language)=? and alias_type<>'DEPRECATED'",(L,)).fetchone()[0]
    nat=con.execute("select count(distinct term_id) from term_aliases where upper(language)=? and jurisdiction is not null",(L,)).fetchone()[0]
    print(L,have,'of',len(terms),' with jurisdiction tag:',nat)
print('terms missing in >=1 of the 13 non-EN languages:')
for t,n in con.execute("select t.term_id||' '||t.canonical_en, 13-count(distinct upper(a.language)) from terms t left join term_aliases a on a.term_id=t.term_id and upper(a.language) in ('DE','NO','SV','FR','NL','DA','FI','ES','IT','PT','JA','KO','ZH') group by t.term_id having 13-count(distinct upper(a.language))>0 order by 2 desc"): print(' ',t,n)
print('language values (raw):', con.execute("select language,count(*) from term_aliases group by 1").fetchall())
print('notes sample:')
for r in con.execute("select term_id,alias,language,alias_type,jurisdiction,substr(notes,1,120) from term_aliases where language in ('JA','ja') and alias_type='TRANSLATION' limit 4"): print(r)
